related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

outcome.implementation_change: Affected-work pressure contexts now include the recorded campaign_objective independently from the work_intent_goal. Missing objectives can enrich a uniquely compatible stable work context; conflicting recorded objective values stay separate.
outcome.analysis_limit: The actual Compiler source record and live projection demonstrate that both objective fields are available. Tests cover distinct objective values, but agent uptake and changes to subsequent development behavior have not been observed.

improvement_relation.basis: The pre-change projection of an authentic Compiler campaign record exposed work_intent_goal but omitted its separately recorded campaign_objective. After the implementation, the same bounded campaign page reports both. Focused regression tests verify missing-objective enrichment for a unique stable context, separation for conflicting objectives, and compatibility with the existing pressure-context and compact-projection behavior.
